items.name: Banking GenAI multi-agent assistant for transaction review
items.summary: Shows how bank users can use GenAI chat to check account balances, review transactions, and initiate payments.

items.name: SAP Cloud SDK on Azure App Service Quickstart (TypeScript)

items.name: API Management with ConferenceAPI and OAuth
items.summary: Deploy Azure API Management with OAuth2-Protected Conference API and Entra ID Integration Using AZD

items.name: Blazor BadgeMaker with Azure AI Services
items.summary: The BadgeMaker is a Blazor front-end application that provides a user-friendly interface for designing and generating digital badges. It allows users to customize badges with various templates, colors, and text options.

items.name: EShopOnWeb VM Architecture
items.summary: This scenario is based on a WebVM and SQLVM architecture, showcasing traditional IAAS in Azure.

items.name: Azure Machine Learning
items.summary: This scenario deploys AzureML Service, together with other resources such as Key Vault, Application Insights, Container Registry and the necessary RBAC permissions.

items.name: Purview Demo Environment
items.summary: This deploys Purview, a storage account, Data factory, Synapse, and a SQL Database. It Adds the storage account and database to collections, creates an runs a pipeline, and reports the lineage.

items.name: Functions E2E HTTP to Event Hubs
items.summary: This demo deploys a flexible, consumption-based Azure Functions app integrated with Event Hubs through private endpoints and a virtual network. It includes load testing, secure networking, and real-time monitoring via Application Insights.

items.name: Tollbooth Serverless Architecture with Azure Functions
items.summary: This scenario deploys the building blocks for a serverless automated parking lot / tollbooth / HOV lanes system using Azure Functions and EventGrid. It also has Azure Storage Account, CosmosDB, Azure KeyVault and Application Insights as part of the architecture.

items.name: LLM Chat Memory with Azure Managed Redis
items.summary: Enable intelligent, memory-enhanced LLM chat experiences using Azure Managed Redis. This template demonstrates how to persist and recall user conversations using AMR as a vector database or key-value store—ideal for building contextual, stateful AI assistants.

items.name: Azure Integration Services Quickstart
items.summary: Deploys Azure Integration Services, including Azure API Management, Function App, Logic App, Service Bus and Event Hubs namespace, along with supporting resources such as Application Insights, Key Vault and Storage Account.

items.name: Call API Management backend with OAuth
items.summary: Demonstrates multiple ways to call OAuth-protected backend APIs through Azure API Management. This template demonstrates three authentication scenarios: Credential Manager, send-request policy with client secret and send-request policy with client certificate (client assertion).

items.name: Call API Management with Managed Identity
items.summary: Demonstrates calling Azure API Management from Azure Functions and Logic Apps using managed identities with OAuth, including one APIM API securely calling another without secrets.

items.name: mTLS with Azure API Management and Application Gateway
items.summary: A demo that shows how to use mutual TLS (mTLS) with Azure API Management and Application Gateway. It shows how to validate client certificates when calling API Management directly and when API Management is behind an Application Gateway.

items.name: Protect API Management with OAuth
items.summary: Demonstrates how to secure an API in Azure API Management with OAuth, including Entra ID app registration examples.

items.name: Track Availability in Application Insights using Standard Test, Azure Function and Logic App Workflow
items.summary: A demo that shows three different ways to track availability in Application Insights using a standard test (webtest), an Azure Function (.NET) and a Logic App workflow

items.name: Azure Serverless App with Angular and MSAL
items.summary: Azure Serverless Template using Angular-standalone, Azure Functions App, Cosmos DB and APIM

items.name: Containerized Apps on Azure Kubernetes Service
items.summary: A base Azure Kubernetes Service template with placeholders to include the application source code (no application source code included) and Kubernetes manifest files.

items.name: Service endpoint, private endpoint and private link service
items.summary: This is a complete demo for Service endpoint, private endpoint and private link service

items.name: Jupyter Notebooks Web App on Azure Container Apps
items.summary: A web application used for hosting, sharing, and interacting with Jupyter Notebooks via Mercury, hosted on Azure Container Apps.

items.name: Azure App Service + Foundry Chat Starter
items.summary: One-click azd template that deploys a Blazor Server chat app on Azure App Service integrated with Azure Foundry, VNet, managed identity, and Application Insights.

items.name: AZ-104 All-in-one demo
items.summary: This project sets up an Azure environment for AZ-104 course demo purposes.

items.name: FastAPI, htmx, TailwindCSS on App Service
items.summary: A sample web app using FastAPI, htmx, and TailwindCSS that demonstrates dynamic design. Does not require a database provision.

items.name: Scalable Django on Azure App Service
items.summary: Deploy your Django web application with Microsoft Azure, for scale, using a cloud architecture with integrated monitoring and load testing.

items.name: Azure Event Hub with Console App
items.summary: This template deploys Azure Event Hub, as well as runs a local Console app on your machine to interact with Publisher and Subscriber events.

items.name: Azure Security Scenarios
items.summary: This scenario is used to demonstrate security principals and deploys Azure Firewall, Front Door, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall to protect OWASP Juice Shop website.

items.name: Introduction to Azure PostgreSQL and AI
items.summary: Azure PostgreSQL & AI Demo offers step-by-step guidance for connecting, configuring, and integrating AI with PostgreSQL in Azure using modern tools.

items.name: Azure Secured Data Solutions
items.summary: This scenario is used to demonstrate different Azure Data Solutions, using secured connectivity.

items.name: Chainlit Agent
items.summary: Chainlit Agent: Intelligent Assistant with Azure AI Agent. With Frontend with chainlit and backend with fastapi. Using Azure AI Agent service for RAG pattern.

items.name: Rust MCP Server on Azure Container Apps
items.summary: A zero-trust, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in Rust on top of axum, deployed to Azure Container Apps with Bicep. Designed as a memory-safe, low-latency option for AI agent tool execution as an alternative to Python or Node.js stacks.
